suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Escalate manual API/runtime verification from guidance to an enforceable contract: if a backend worker claims `followedProcedure=true` on work that requires manual verification, the handoff should include `interactiveChecks`; otherwise the worker should set `followedProcedure=false` with an explicit deviation. Consider enforcing this in the worker procedure or validation flow instead of relying on skill text alone.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The `fix-e2e-scrutiny-round2` review found that `.factory/skills/backend-worker/SKILL.md` already requires manual API verification plus `interactiveChecks`, but the corresponding handoff still reported `followedProcedure=true` with no `interactiveChecks` and no recorded `curl.exe` validation steps in the transcript skeleton.
